name: SE-Education Public Company Limited
summary: SE-Education Public Company Limited, along with its affiliated companies, operates a chain of bookstores across Thailand. The organization's activities are divided into three principal divisions: Retail Business, Other Distribution Channels, and School Business. Its retail footprint includes SE-ED book centers, a network of partner stores, and numerous university bookstores, spanning both Bangkok and other Thai provinces. The company also engages in publishing, producing general, academic, and educational books, in addition to monthly periodicals. Furthermore, SE-Education oversees Plearnpattana School, which offers a comprehensive educational curriculum from pre-kindergarten through Matayom 6. The company's diverse services also encompass consulting, the design, development, and distribution of software and hardware solutions, and the wholesale distribution of books to other retailers. Established in 1974, the firm maintains its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand.
